title: Sing, for I Will Come
old_p1: Zechariah was a young prophet in Haggai’s day. A prophet speaks for Heavenly Father.
The Lord showed him a man with a measuring line, a long rope for measuring. Zechariah asked, “Where are you going?” “To measure Jerusalem,” the man said.
Long ago, cities had stone walls to keep people safe. But the Lord said, “I will be a wall of fire all around her.”
old_p2: Fire gives light and keeps danger away. The Lord said, “Sing and be happy! I come, and I will live with you.” The Lord is Jesus. Latter-day prophets teach that He will come again!
Jesus wants to be close to you too. Tonight, snuggle in and feel happy. Jesus wants to be near you!
p1: Zechariah shared Heavenly Father’s words. The people were home in Jerusalem again. But the walls that kept them safe were still broken.
Zechariah saw a man with a long rope for measuring. “Where are you going?” he asked. “To measure Jerusalem,” the man said.
So many people would live there, they would spread past any wall. “I will be a wall of fire all around her,” said the Lord.
p2: A wall of fire glows bright and keeps danger away. “Sing and be happy!” the Lord said. “For I come, and I will live with you.” The Lord who said this is Jesus.
When you wonder, you can ask, just like Zechariah. Tonight, hum a happy song. Jesus loves to be near you.

p2_christian: A wall of fire glows bright and keeps danger away. “Sing and be happy!” the Lord said. “For I come, and I will live with you.” Years later, Jesus came to live with His people.
When you wonder, you can ask, just like Zechariah. Tonight, hum a happy song. Jesus loves to be near you.
